decks.notes: This deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo using Gyruda, Doom of Depths and Keruga, the Macrosage as companions. The key strategy involves using Leyline Binding to control the board while setting up for the combo. Spinewoods Armadillo and Trumpeting Carnosaur provide additional value and control, while Spark Double and Release to the Wind offer flexibility and recursion. The mana base is focused on consistency and versatility, with various triomes and land cards to support the deck's goals. Overall, the deck aims to discover synergies and create explosive plays to secure victory.

The main focus of this deck is to control and manipulate the game through counterspells, removal, and card advantage. By utilizing powerful control spells like Fatal Push, Thoughtseize, and Narset, Parter of Veils, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan and gain incremental advantages. The addition of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for extra card advantage and flexibility in gameplay. The deck also includes powerful finishers like The Meathook Massacre and Stormchaser's Talent to close out the game once control has been established.

This deck focuses on using Enigmatic Incarnation to search for and play powerful creatures in order to control the game. The deck includes a variety of Overlord creatures and other strong creatures to take advantage of the enchantment's ability. The deck also includes several lands and spells to support the strategy, as well as a companion in Yorion, Sky Nomad for additional value. The key concept is to use Enigmatic Incarnation to tutor for creatures and establish a strong board presence to dominate the game.

The main concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to flood the board with low-cost aggressive creatures such as Monastery Swiftspear and Heartfire Hero, while utilizing burn spells like Reckless Rage and Fatal Push to control the board and clear the way for attacks. The deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a combination of direct damage, creature aggression, and efficient removal spells. The inclusion of cards like Kumano Faces Kakkazan and Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance further amplifies the deck's aggression and potential damage output.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize green devotion cards to quickly ramp up mana and overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures. By using cards like Llanowar Elves and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, the deck aims to generate a significant amount of mana to cast powerful spells and creatures like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll. The deck also includes cards like Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Storm the Festival to provide additional value and creature summoning. Overall, this deck focuses on creating a fast and formidable board presence to outpace and overpower opponents.

The main focus of this Gruul Aggro deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. The key strategy involves using efficient creatures like Emberheart Challenger and Manifold Mouse to deal damage quickly, while also utilizing burn spells like Burst Lightning and Reckless Rage to control the board and finish off opponents. The deck aims to maintain pressure and tempo throughout the game by playing a mix of creatures and burn spells, ultimately aiming to deal lethal damage before the opponent can stabilize.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells in order to quickly reduce their life total to zero. The deck utilizes efficient low-cost creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Heartfire Hero, along with powerful pump spells like Infuriate and Monstrous Rage, to deal damage quickly. It also includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Reckless Rage to clear the way for its creatures. The deck aims to maintain pressure on the opponent and close out the game before they have a chance to stabilize.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. Utilizing a mix of efficient removal, hand disruption, and powerful creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse, this deck aims to apply pressure early and close out games fast. With a strong mana base and a blend of creature and spell threats, this deck is designed to be a relentless force on the battlefield, punishing opponents for any missteps and maintaining board control throughout the game.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on playing aggressive creatures and burn spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent. The key strategy is to apply pressure early with efficient creatures like Kumano Faces Kakkazan and Emberheart Challenger, while using burst damage spells like Burst Lightning and Reckless Rage to clear the way and finish off the opponent. The deck also includes some protection spells like Snakeskin Veil to help keep your creatures alive and disruptive lands like Den of the Bugbear to further disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The main strategy of this deck revolves around utilizing Enigmatic Incarnation to consistently tutor for powerful creatures such as Overlord of the Balemurk, Zur, Eternal Schemer, and Overlord of the Mistmoors. The deck also includes a variety of versatile creatures and enchantments to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Yorion, Sky Nomad serves as a companion to provide additional value and synergy with the deck's flicker effects. The mana base is carefully constructed to ensure consistency and access to all necessary colors for casting spells and activating abilities.

This Golgari Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays, utilizing cards like Tyvar, Jubilant Brawler and Rubblebelt Maverick to quickly overwhelm opponents. It also includes disruptive elements like Fatal Push and Priest of Forgotten Gods to control the board. The deck includes a mix of graveyard interaction with cards like Stitcher's Supplier and Deathrite Shaman, as well as ramp options with Agatha's Soul Cauldron and Cult Conscript. The mana base is carefully crafted to ensure consistent access to both colors and enable powerful plays early in the game.

The main concept of this deck is to build a fast and aggressive strategy by utilizing low-cost creatures and direct damage spells to quickly reduce the opponent's life total. The inclusion of Obosh, the Preypiercer as a companion enhances this aggro strategy by providing additional damage output. By consistently applying pressure with creatures like Soul-Scar Mage and Monastery Swiftspear, as well as utilizing burn spells like Thud and Titan's Strength, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize or mount a defense.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on early aggression with cards like Bloodtithe Harvester and Blightstep Pathway, backed up by disruption and removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize. It also utilizes powerful finishers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Fear of Missing Out to maintain pressure on the opponent. The deck aims to quickly deplete the opponent's resources and close out the game before they can stabilize, making it a formidable force in the Pioneer 1 vs 1 format.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells in order to quickly reduce their life total to zero. By playing a combination of low-cost creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Emberheart Challenger, along with burn spells like Fatal Push and Reckless Rage, the deck aims to apply constant pressure on the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Kumano Faces Kakkazan and Screaming Nemesis further adds to the aggressive nature of the deck, making it difficult for the opponent to stabilize and turn the game in their favor.

This Selesnya Aggro deck focuses on quickly establishing a board presence with efficient creatures and disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Archon of Emeria. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and tempo plays, utilizing cards like Collected Company to generate additional threats. The inclusion of cards like Skyclave Apparition provides removal options while Anointed Peacekeeper helps to protect key creatures. Overall, the deck is designed to apply pressure early and maintain control of the battlefield throughout the game.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruption spells. The deck includes cards like Thoughtseize, Fatal Push, and Duress to disrupt the opponent's game plan while playing threats like Bloodtithe Harvester and Blade of the Oni to quickly close out the game. Mutavault provides additional pressure while cards like Fear of Missing Out and Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance help maintain card advantage. The deck's flexible mana base allows for consistent and powerful plays, making it a formidable force in the Pioneer format.
